decisive_spans.text: Abdominal Ultrasound: Revealed an 8.4 × 11 × 13 cm liver abscess
Blood and wound cultures grew Klebsiella pneumoniae

response.rationale: D6 (Klebsiella pneumoniae liver abscess) is directly supported by the presence of a liver abscess on ultrasound and Klebsiella pneumoniae in blood and wound cultures. D4 (Liver abscess) is also supported but is less specific than D6.
